options.prompt: Art style, identical for every asset in this game: chunky rounded vector shapes, flat two-step shading (one base colour plus one darker plane at the bottom) with a single cream glossy highlight in the upper left, uniform outline in a low-luminance shade of the object's own base hue, no gradient, no airbrush, no texture, no visible brush strokes, no pixel art. Palette: pastel bakery colours in their saturated variants - strawberry pink #F7C6D9, mint #B8E6D5, butter #F9E7A0, lavender #D9C6F0, cocoa #8B5E3C. Character: a small chibi chef, two heads tall, big round head with a tall white chef hat, white double-breasted chef jacket with a red neckerchief, black-and-white checkered trousers, short arms and two short legs with black shoes, dark brown hair, confident smile with determined eyebrows. Viewpoint: front-facing three-quarter hero pose for a lobby showcase, full body from hat to shoes, standing upright on an invisible floor. Composition: one single character centred in a tall portrait frame filling about 90 percent of the frame height, feet at the bottom centre. Transparent background, no text, no watermark, no drop shadow, no ground shadow, no frame, no photographic texture. Subject: a 2-cell sprite sheet, one row with two columns, of the SAME chibi chef in two variants. Left cell: holding a large chef's kitchen knife raised in the right hand with a crisp white gleam on the blade, left hand on hip, confident hero pose. Right cell: holding a red ketchup squeeze gun pointed forward in the right hand, left hand on hip, confident hero pose. Both cells identical character design, identical size and pose except the held item, each chef centred in its tall cell filling about 90 percent of the cell height with feet on the same baseline, wide empty margin between the two cells so they never touch. Fully transparent background, no grid lines, no borders, no numbers, no text.
